units: <cite ref="Ketubot 85b:7">Keth. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>ואי … דגִ׳ ביה הא גִ׳ ביה</he> (Ar. … <he>דגייס … גָס ביה</he>) but if it is one who is familiar with him (so as to use his name without a title), then, we may say, he spoke of him in a familiar way.—Fem. <cite ref="C00710"><he>גָּיְיסָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:13">Kidd. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ ביה</he> she was on familiar terms with him.—Pl. <he>גִּיסֵי</he>, <he>גָיְיסֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 33a:16">Ib. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>דגִי׳ בה רבנן</he> where scholars are a familiar sight (and no attention is paid them).
<cite ref="Ketubot 28a:5">Keth. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>גיי׳ בהדדי</he> they are intimate with each other.
